summary: Yimutian Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on August 31, 2026. Shareholders approved a special resolution increasing the voting rights of Class B ordinary shares from 20 to 1,000 votes per share, an ordinary resolution increasing authorized share capital from US$200,000 to US$2,000,000 with corresponding expansions in authorized share classes, and adoption of the Fourteenth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. This is a routine corporate governance matter with no special-situation transaction.
